full_install.source_note: The frozen release was built on 4806716 plus the recorded permission repair. Commit 2bfb28f contains that source before rebasing onto later main. Regenerated export definitions have the exact same nonempty line multisets as the compile-time definitions; the equivalence record and final export check are preserved.
full_install.limitations: This compares integrated releases, not an isolated optimization. The quiet-start prerequisite is observed only before launch. Own workers are excluded using a Job snapshot followed by a live membership recheck. Short-lived foreign processes may escape sampling, and observed competitor CPU sums cover only identities present in consecutive samples.
